teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering variables, conditionals, lists, and dictionaries, and answered student questions during office hours.
Graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric as part of assigned teaching assistant activities.

teaching.title: Beginning Programming Tutor
bullets: Guided beginning programmers through practice exercises on lists and dictionaries during programming tutoring sessions.
Discussed debugging approaches with beginning programmers during tutoring sessions focused on programming practice.

projects.title: Command-Line Expense Tracker
bullets: Implemented a small command-line expense tracker using Python functions and collections for an individual undergraduate course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, using Git as a project tool.
